request_slots.evidence: Service.run holds self.fifo; /props total_slots=1; observed one active and one queued.

limitations: Two active request executors are unsupported by this pinned Strata server; multi-GPU still has one slot.
The synthetic inputs and handbook outputs do not establish performance for all real workloads.
Inference-handbook runs sometimes ended while discussing chat stop-marker syntax; actual shorter outputs are retained.
The neutral gardening comparison completed exactly 4096 output tokens on every mode; one trial per mode.
Cold means zero KV-prefix reuse, not cold host file cache or cold adaptive expert cache. Host workloads were not isolated.
Mode-dependent arithmetic and cache residency can produce different answers to identical requests.
Client delivery events are not necessarily one token each; throughput uses API token counts.
No tensor/expert split, alternative split points, CPU thread allocation sweep, or two-replica deployment was tested.
